autonomy_tiers.name: advisory_only
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may analyze or propose, but may not change tracked or external state.

autonomy_tiers.name: draft_and_prepare
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may prepare drafts or task records, but not finalize sensitive outcomes without acceptance.

autonomy_tiers.name: internal_execution
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may change tracked repo files and private runtime within an approved task.

autonomy_tiers.name: external_action_with_review
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may prepare external actions, but execution requires review or approval.

autonomy_tiers.name: human_only
autonomy_tiers.description: Only a human may approve or perform this action.

risk_tiers.description: Internal documentation, research, analysis, and low-cost reversible work.
Changes to shared truth, workflows, scripts, or multi-file coordination with reversible impact.
External writes, spend, deployments, legal/public commitments, destructive or irreversible actions.

human_only_actions: any public statement or publication on behalf of the company
any unbudgeted spend or money movement
any destructive delete of tracked source-of-truth files
any grant of new external system write access
governor_review_required_for: all changes to control-plane policy or workflow files
all tasks with autonomy tier A3
all tasks that touch more than one system of record

kill_switches: missing telemetry for a high-risk action
rework_or_rollback_rate exceeds the accepted weekly threshold
documentation_rule: Documentation may sync shared truth only after acceptance or explicit CEO override.
board_rule: Render `02 Planning/Task Board.md` from `05 AI Control Plane/active-work.json` after material queue changes.
